verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's official help documents command-line start parameters that let it run headless: batch conversion with --convert-to/--outdir, text dumping with --cat, batch printing and macro execution. A community user confirms running it in Docker to generate PDFs, which corroborates scripted use. missing for 10: a dedicated CLI tool rather than start parameters of the GUI application, machine-readable/structured output or error reporting suited to agents, and documentation aimed at AI-native or agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Starts in "headless mode" which allows using the application without user interface.
--cat Applies filter "txt:Text" to the following text documents and dump text content to console (implies --headless).
--print-to-file [--printer-name printer_name] [--outdir output_dir] Batch-print files to file.
Also runs it in Docker to generate PDFs from templates and normalize document formats.
